border-color-translucent.$description: Translucent border color that blends with backgrounds using rgba().

body-color.$description: Default body text color. Applied to the <body> element and inherited by all text content unless overridden.

body-bg.$description: Default body background color. Applied to the <body> element as the base page background.

emphasis-color.$description: Emphasis color for higher contrast text. Use for headings or text that needs to stand out.

secondary-color.$description: Secondary text color for lighter, less prominent text. Use for captions, labels, or helper text.

secondary-bg.$description: Secondary background color. Use for dividers and to indicate disabled component states.

tertiary-color.$description: Tertiary text color for even lighter text. Use for less important supporting text.

tertiary-bg.$description: Tertiary background color. Use for hover states, accents, and wells.

link-color.$description: Default hyperlink color. Used for all <a> elements and interactive text.

link-hover-color.$description: Hyperlink hover color. Applied when user hovers over a link.

border-color.$description: Default border color for component borders, dividers, and rules.

primary-text-emphasis.$description: Primary text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

primary-bg-subtle.$description: Primary subtle background color for non-intrusive backgrounds.

primary-border-subtle.$description: Primary subtle border color for gentle borders matching primary theme.

secondary-text-emphasis.$description: Secondary theme text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

secondary-bg-subtle.$description: Secondary theme subtle background color for non-intrusive backgrounds.

secondary-border-subtle.$description: Secondary theme subtle border color for gentle borders matching secondary theme.

success-text-emphasis.$description: Success text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

success-bg-subtle.$description: Success subtle background color for non-intrusive success states.

success-border-subtle.$description: Success subtle border color for gentle borders matching success theme.

danger-text-emphasis.$description: Danger text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

danger-bg-subtle.$description: Danger subtle background color for non-intrusive error states.

danger-border-subtle.$description: Danger subtle border color for gentle borders matching danger theme.

warning-text-emphasis.$description: Warning text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

warning-bg-subtle.$description: Warning subtle background color for non-intrusive warning states.

warning-border-subtle.$description: Warning subtle border color for gentle borders matching warning theme.

info-text-emphasis.$description: Info text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

info-bg-subtle.$description: Info subtle background color for non-intrusive info states.

info-border-subtle.$description: Info subtle border color for gentle borders matching info theme.

light-text-emphasis.$description: Light text emphasis color - provides contrast on light themed components.

light-bg-subtle.$description: Light subtle background color for subtle backgrounds.

light-border-subtle.$description: Light subtle border color for gentle borders matching light theme.

dark-text-emphasis.$description: Dark text emphasis color - highest contrast text on light backgrounds.

dark-bg-subtle.$description: Dark subtle background color for darker backgrounds.

dark-border-subtle.$description: Dark subtle border color for borders matching dark theme.
